name: Kerr Sigma
notes: Boyer-Lindquist radial-angular combination appearing in the Kerr line element.

name: Kerr Delta
notes: Horizon function; roots of Delta=0 locate the inner and outer Kerr horizons.

name: Kerr metric (Boyer-Lindquist)
expression: ds^2 = -(1 - 2 M r / Sigma) dt^2 - (4 M a r sin^2 theta / Sigma) dt dphi + (Sigma / Delta) dr^2 + Sigma dtheta^2 + (r^2 + a^2 + 2 M a^2 r sin^2 theta / Sigma) sin^2 theta dphi^2
notes: Rotating vacuum black hole in Boyer-Lindquist coordinates. Recovers Schwarzschild when a=0.

name: Kerr outer horizon
notes: Larger root of Delta=0, assuming |a| <= M. The inner horizon is r_- = M - sqrt(M^2 - a^2).

name: Kerr static limit
expression: r_ergo(theta) = M + sqrt(M^2 - a^2 cos^2 theta)
notes: Surface g_tt=0. It coincides with r_+ at the poles and lies outside the horizon at the equator.

name: Schwarzschild metric
expression: ds^2 = -(1 - 2 M / r) dt^2 + (1 - 2 M / r)^{-1} dr^2 + r^2 (dtheta^2 + sin^2 theta dphi^2)
notes: Kerr with a=0. Horizon at r=2M.

name: Lanczos-Israel equation
notes: Jump [K_ab] in extrinsic curvature across the shell determines the surface stress-energy S_ab.

name: Thin-shell throat dynamics
expression: dot(a)^2 + V(a) = 0,  V(a) = f(a) - (2 pi sigma a)^2
notes: Schematic Israel-junction reduction for a spherical thin shell of surface density sigma. f(a) is the metric function on each side of the throat.

name: Second derivative stability criterion
notes: Local stability of an equilibrium throat radius a_0 requires a potential minimum.

name: Morris-Thorne flare-out
notes: Shape function b(r) must meet the throat and open outward. This typically forces a NEC violation.

name: Null energy condition
expression: T_mu_nu k^mu k^nu >= 0  for all null k^mu
notes: Ordinary matter satisfies the NEC. Traversable wormhole throats generally require a local violation.
